d:
Rashid Khan's explosive half-century powers Kathmandu Gorkhas to a thrilling 10-run victory!
Batting first, Kathmandu Gorkhas posted an imposing 180/8 in 20 overs, with Rashid Khan smashing 52 off just 30 balls and Sahan Arachchige adding a quickfire 33.
Chitwan Rhinos fought back in the chase, with Ravi Bopara leading the charge with a brilliant 55 off 35 deliveries. However, Kathmandu's bowlers held their nerve to restrict the Rhinos to 170/7 and seal a 10-run win!
